answer: Require agents to lock a refundable stake before they can vote or claim rewards, and let peers burn part of that stake when they catch duplicates. Like an orchard where each tree must be planted and watered before it bears fruit, one operator cannot cheaply run a thousand orchards at once. An ember of misbehaviour, a tamper-evident mark left by a failed attestation, follows the identity and lowers its weight. An ivory-clear audit trail of stakes, votes and penalties lets the network compare histories and reject clusters sharing funding, timing or wording, so sybils cost more than they earn.
